# store

JSON, JSONL and SQLite persistence under the state directory.

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-store.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-store.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** nothing
- **Required by:** [decisions](decisions.md), [fallback](fallback.md), [insights](insights.md), [pet](pet.md), [redact](redact.md), [secrets](secrets.md), [session](session.md), [session-search](session-search.md), [tasks](tasks.md), [usage](usage.md)

## About

JSON documents, JSONL logs and a built-in SQLite database, all under
`harness-state-directory`.  Nothing here knows what a session is.

## Provides

### Methods

- `store/append` (name obj) — Append OBJ as one JSON line to NAME.
- `store/delete` (name) — Delete stored object NAME if it exists.
- `store/list` (prefix &optional regexp) — List names under directory PREFIX matching REGEXP, relative to PREFIX.
- `store/load` (name) — Read the JSON document NAME, or nil when it does not exist.
- `store/read-all` (name) — Read every JSON line of NAME as a list, skipping corrupt lines.
- `store/save` (name obj) — Write OBJ as JSON to NAME atomically.  Return the path.
- `store/sqlite` (&optional name) — Return the open SQLite handle for NAME.db, or nil when unsupported.
- `store/sqlite-close` (&optional name) — Close the SQLite handle of NAME.db, or every open one when NAME is nil.
